about.title: We make <accent>stories</accent> the way others fold paper.
about.lead: Lunireve is a big library of stories for children aged 1 to 12, to read and to listen to. Stories to personalise, to make interactive, and even to print and keep as a memory.
about.storyP1: It began one December evening. Our six-year-old daughter asked for a story where she would be the hero, "for real". We opened a notebook, and in two voices, we made up an adventure on a night train. She fell asleep before the end. The next day, she asked for another.
about.storyP2: We looked around: apps, podcasts, personalised books. Nothing brought together a large library, a voice reading aloud, and the tenderness of a story written for one specific child, at a normal family price. So we decided to build it.
about.storyP3: Lunireve is an extensive library of stories where everyone will find something they love and can listen to. Where a story can be deeply personalised to match what you want, where it can be printed as a real book and delivered to you, or lived as an interactive story where you choose what comes next. The ideal solution for your bedtime routine.
about.servicesTitle: Four ways to enjoy a story
about.svcLibraryDesc: Dozens of original stories, sorted by age, theme and length, to read and listen to for free, as many times as you like.
about.svcInteractiveDesc: At each step, the reader chooses what happens next. The story changes every time, no more reading the same one over and over.
about.svcPersonalizedDesc: Your child becomes the hero: their name, the character of their choice, the setting and the style. A unique story in minutes.
about.svcPrintedDesc: Turn your child's favourite story into a beautiful bound book, to gift or keep as a lasting memory. Coming soon.
about.valueLiteraryDesc: Published authors, a French editorial sensibility, a language you enjoy hearing.
about.valueFamilyDesc: Our stories last exactly the time of a shared moment, never too short, never endless.
about.valueCraftedDesc: Our stories are generated under precise writing rules, sample-checked, and corrected as soon as a reader reports an issue.
about.valueBilingualDesc: French and English, written separately, not machine-translated. Because two languages grow together.
about.trustSubtitle: A parent's trust isn't a given. We earn it every day, through visible choices.
about.trustGdprDesc: Your data and your children's stays in Europe, encrypted, never sold. Deleted on request.
about.trustAiDesc: Our stories, illustrations and voices are created with artificial intelligence. It says so here, in plain words, and everywhere on the platform.
about.trustPediatricDesc: Personalised printed books are proofread page by page by a human before shipping. It is our strictest commitment.
about.ctaTitle: Open a book, close a screen.
about.ctaBody: Create a free account and listen to your first story tonight. No credit card, no commitment.

create.faqQ1: Is creating a personalised story free?
create.faqA1: Yes, the free plan includes 3 personalised stories per month. Paid plans add more, with extra personalisation options.
create.faqQ2: What place should I enter for my story?
create.faqA2: A real or imaginary place: grandma's house, a magical forest, outer space... The place will explicitly appear in the story.
create.faqQ3: I don't know which theme to pick
create.faqA3: Start from your child's passions: animals, space, magic... When in doubt, Adventure and Fantasy work for almost every age. The optional angle lets you refine afterwards.
create.faqA4: They make the story livelier and closer to your child's world: a little brother, grandma, the cuddly toy or an imaginary friend can become adventure companions.
create.faqQ5: What extra information can I add?
create.faqA5: Simple sentences to weave into the story: it should mention school, the hero is afraid of the dark, their little sister is 3... Up to 3 notes.
